# authwise_application (Resource)

An application of an issuer: something that signs people in or calls an API. On the wire it is an OAuth 2.0 client, and its identifier (`c-…`) is its `client_id`.

Formerly `authwise_client` (kit#968): a `moved` block from `authwise_client` carries the state across, with `client_id` read as `application_id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Issuer-scoped: an application for a browser app (an OIDC client), calling the API its
# audience names.
resource "authwise_audience" "api" {
  display_name = "https://api.example.com"
}

data "authwise_interactive_client_config" "console" {
  allowed_redirect_uris = ["https://console.example.com/callback"]
}

resource "authwise_application" "console" {
  display_name = "Console"
  audience_id  = authwise_audience.api.audience_id
  grant_types  = ["authorization_code", "refresh_token"]
  config       = data.authwise_interactive_client_config.console.any
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `grant_types` (List of String)

### Optional

- `application_url` (String)
- `audience_id` (String)
- `config` (String) `config` as protojson-encoded google.protobuf.Any (JSON object with `@type`); reference a generated config data source's `any` output for the type-safe form.
- `display_name` (String)
- `expires_at` (String) `expires_at` as an RFC 3339 timestamp.
- `issuer_id` (String) Parent identifier `issuer_id`; overrides the provider default, and reads back from the name. Changing a configured one replaces the resource.
- `kind` (String)
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `login_url` (String)
- `post_logout_redirect_uris` (List of String)
- `status` (String)
- `tenant_id` (String) Parent identifier `tenant_id`; overrides the provider default, and reads back from the name. Changing a configured one replaces the resource.
- `theme_variant_id` (String)
- `token_endpoint_auth_method` (String)

### Read-Only

- `application_id` (String) Server-assigned resource id — the last segment of `name`, and what other resources' `*_id` attributes take.
- `name` (String) Full resource name; serves as the Terraform ID.
- `owning_tenant_id` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by full resource name.
terraform import authwise_application.example tenants/t-01/issuers/i-01/applications/c-01
```
